title: Implement 60 bosses, seven survivor motion sets, profiles and Windows/LAN playtest
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord runs sixty distinct boss encounters with individual original themes, seven classes, 378 skills, twenty-eight weapons and six different map footprints. Five modes include timed campaigns, three-fight Grand Raid, seeded uncapped Endless scheduling and an optional Uncounted extension that preserves each player's banked campaign clear.

All seven survivors have independent directional runs, idle, primary attack, hurt, dodge and downed clips: 820 selected poses. Hollow Constable adds nineteen idle/hurt/stagger/defeat poses alongside its unchanged eight-frame attack, bringing selected production motion to 1,442 production-path poses plus eight retained Constable proof poses. Its anticipation now waits for authoritative release, Accord shows a stagger loop, and defeat settles once on world time after combat stops. Exact prompts, native returns, references, superseded attempts and independent pixel reconstruction are retained. Special-ability and many other boss animation sets remain unfinished.

ProfileV1 preserves mastery, rescues, lore, cosmetics, bests and settings. Personal full-Hard participation gates higher difficulty without permanent combat power. Remappable keyboard/mouse/gamepad, Hold/Toggle actions, touch and fifteen locale catalogs are connected. Boss-history translation and native-language review remain open. One dated history drives the in-game journal, repository and seventeen-page Wiki, illustrated with twenty publicly verified images.

Presentation uses a bounded fifty-millisecond drawing clock; state transitions remain authoritative. Runtime copies reduce survivor atlas decoded RGBA from 485,359,616 to 221,347,840 bytes while preserving world size and selected frames. Current-boss loading retains eight shared actor atlases, exact identities for 57 deferred bosses and at most two full dynamic atlases. That encounter set falls from 306,708,480 to at most 80,805,888 dimension-based decoded bytes. These are separate from driver allocations, rendered FPS and device budgets.

Encounter-duration health scaling and friendly projectile damage to Walking District buildings are corrected. Evidence includes 210 progression combinations, 2,436 fixture clears, 2,226 restores and 1,740 health/deadline cases. A frozen-source one-hour localhost probe maintains fifty SDK clients and 4,000 hostile projectiles: 108,001 ticks, 21.41 ms p99, 112.11 ms worst and 236 ticks over 33.33 ms. Raw samples, failed setup attempts, frozen bundles and source identities are retained. Invulnerable fixture players and zero rendered clients leave normal progression, hosted/WAN and rendered capacity as separate gates.

61 compressed music deliveries retain audited WAV fallback and decoded-duration checks. The immutable [Windows development download](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/releases/tag/dev-windows-20261024-1), source 52552c0, contains offline play, bundled art/audio/fonts and opt-in private-IPv4 LAN hosting. Fresh extraction and ordinary Windows copies match every member and pass scoped native fixtures; this issued archive predates the newer motion work.

Authenticated bounded recovery retains fifty developed builds and 2,400 purchase replies through actual HTTP/file-backed process replacement and competing-owner claims. Expansion/HTTP limits remain enforced. The normal public writer is disabled; participant credentials, worst-case paging, durable departures and verified hosted rankings/recovery remain unfinished.

Validation: 336 rules, input, history, profile, WebSocket, HTTP and SQL tests; authored-content/fifteen-locale checks; TypeScript; production build; independent native-art reconstruction; exact public Wiki image bytes. Source/build identities are in reviews/runtime-verification.json. Browser control is disabled; no new rendered acceptance is claimed.

Keep this PR draft and protected main unchanged. Final encounter balance, terrain finish, special/boss animation, translations, listening/playtesting, physical devices, native-language review, hosted services, mixed progression/endurance/capacity and coordinated final release remain open. The public Site still serves its earlier protocol-4 build.

Constable metadata provenance binds both the historical Windows CRLF bytes and exact Git LF blob. The first Ubuntu CI hash-check failure and original issued receipts are preserved; changed JSON values or extra bytes remain rejected.

All six arenas now have painted ground: the original Gatehouse plus five new native material paintings. Exact existing bounds, cover and spawns are retained in gameplay and setup previews. Independent crop/resample reconstruction, all-map layer/placement tests and a static Wiki comparison are included. The five new textures imply 24.39 MiB decoded RGBA; rendered readability and actual GPU/device budgets remain open.

Seven opening bosses now have eight-pose defeats, preserving all original live action pixels and world transforms. All nine opening identities settle once on authoritative world time, with correct static final-pose fallbacks during loading/retry. The current expanded encounter cache estimate is 72.40625 MiB startup and 93.65625 MiB maximum retained. Exact original/new RGBA reconstruction and five authority/reward/fallback regressions are included; rendered/device/human review remains open.
